title: Prof. Thomas Seyfried - 'Cancer as a Metabolic Disease: Implications for Novel Therapies'
summary: A lecture by Prof. Thomas Seyfried arguing that cancer is primarily a metabolic disease rather than a genetic one. It covers the Warburg effect, mitochondrial damage and implications for therapies.
why: HN people recommend it for its interesting, if contested, theory of cancer's root cause, noting the content matters more than the delivery.

quote.text: This video [1] is worth a watch to learn a bit more about cancer as a metabolic disease.
